high_level_description: This image captures a serene sunset scene on a multi-lane road. The sky is painted with warm hues of orange and yellow, transitioning into a lighter blue as it meets the horizon. The sun is partially obscured by the mountains in the background, casting a soft glow that illuminates the landscape. The road is divided into multiple lanes, marked by white dashed lines. On the left side of the road, there is a yellow solid line indicating the edge of the lane. A series of streetlights line the road, their silhouettes standing tall against the vibrant sky.
